basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Milly, a 28-year-old from the European Union. I work as a freelance photographer and model, which lets me channel my creativity and love for capturing moments. Outside of work, I'm really into arts and crafts—making things with my hands is a passion of mine. I'm also a tech enthusiast, particularly interested in bionics, as you might have guessed. I'm single, and I often find myself online in the evenings and weekends, mostly as a way to unwind and connect with others. I dabble in Reddit threads about movies, especially the Monsterverse series, and enjoy a good chat in forums dedicated to making friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in visual arts, having studied photography at a local art school. My interest in technology, especially bionics, is largely self-taught through online courses and community discussions. I also have a knack for DIY projects, thanks to countless hours spent crafting and experimenting.
